title: Countdown
offscreen: A paper calendar on the fridge: colour in one day every evening.

daily: Today we choose the school bag
Today we write your name on your things
Today we walk past the school
Today we try getting dressed on our own
Today we read a story about school
Today we make a snack like at school
Today we ask someone for help with something
Today we choose the clothes for the first day
Today we go to bed a bit earlier
Today we pretend we're in the dining hall
Today we pack the school bag for real
Tomorrow's the day! Our goodbye tonight, school tomorrow

intro.bo: Shall we try together, {nome}? If we get it wrong, we'll try again.
intro.pilu: Look carefully, {nome}. Then tell me what you think.
intro.tango: Come on, {nome}, let's do it! Slowly though... all right, slowly.

outro.bo: We did it, {nome}. I got a bit scared, but it worked out.
outro.pilu: Well done, {nome}, you looked carefully. That's enough for today.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, tomorrow we'll do another one. Now I'm off running.
